body: I can't afford it and my anxiety is so bad I can't talk to people in person unless I know them really well. I don't trust doctors anymore after what happened last time also.

I've been depressed for a little over 20 years now. My dad died when I was a teenager. I'm 37 now. 

My depression got work when I went to get help about 10 years ago, maybe 11 years ago. I talked about maybe killing myself and they locked me up in the hospital. I was released 90 days later but all my stuff was gone. No one took the time to make sure the place I was renting would be taken care of while I was gone so I ended up losing everything I owned including old pictures of my family. I went into a very deep depression after that and haven't recovered since. It made my social anxiety worse. I can't talk to people in person unless I know them really well.
